title: A Time of Dread
author: John Gwynne
review:
Took a while to get going but eventually got pretty interesting. Malice was the better starting book, for this one the characters mostly stay in the same spot and then some major events happen towards the end so it feels less dynamic than the preceding series.

I will say that this book is darker than Faithful and the fallen which I'm digging. There's some messed up stuff that happens and I hope it gets even darker. I'm also hoping that it's less good vs evil and more gray than FATF, so far it's maybe a little less clear cut, but the bad guys are REALLY bad but the side of good is a little more fuzzy.

Overall an enjoyable read but nothing earth shattering.
